settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: English is the default. You can switch to Chinese at any time.
settings.apiSubtitle: Manage text models and media generation services.
settings.textHelp: DeepSeek / compatible API for Creative Assistant, previz director and scene planning.
settings.mediaHelp: Uses the local CLI authorization; a quote is shown before any generation.
settings.mediaNodeHelp: Start image/video generation from a node toolbar; find tasks under Tasks at the top.
settings.seedreamHelp: Used by the canvas node “Seedream image”. The key stays on this computer and never enters the project or repository.

task.title: Task center
task.subtitle: Creation, images, videos and exports in one place. Restore only checks existing tasks and never re-submits.
task.empty: No tasks yet; start from a node tool or Creative Assistant.
task.queryIncomplete: Query incomplete: {error}; last known status kept.

error.network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
error.unauthorized: API key is missing or invalid.
error.rateLimited: Rate limit or quota reached. Try again later.
error.modelNotOpen: This model is not enabled for your account.
error.invalidInput: Please check the input and try again.
error.notImplemented: This feature is not available yet.
error.paymentRequired: Payment is required. Please top up your Volcengine account and try again.

project.savedHint:
Each project is saved separately.
Export important work as backup.
project.title: Projects
project.selection: Click to select · double-click to open
project.selectionHint: Click to select · double-click to open
project.newHint: Blank canvas, start a new story
project.emptyTrashHint: Projects in trash keep their assets and can be restored.
project.emptySearchHint: Try another name or clear the search.
project.dialogSubtitle: Projects are saved independently. Return to Projects anytime.
project.archiveToast: Project moved to trash; restorable anytime

canvas.offlineHint: Click a thumbnail to add to the director · fully offline
canvas.hint: V select / H hand · drag empty space to box-select · Shift / ⌘+click to add · Space temporary hand · middle-drag or Shift+wheel to pan · wheel zoom · F fit · drag files from Finder · right-click a node for actions

stage.stageCaption: WASD move · QE up/down · IJKL / left-drag turn · right-drag pan · Alt+wheel FOV
stage.timelineHint: Alt+wheel zoom · Shift+wheel pan · middle-drag pan
stage.timelineHelp: Drag to retime · Delete to remove · Double-click to edit

edit.title: Edit
edit.subtitle: Rough cut & export · {timecode} · {seconds}s · {fps} fps
edit.libraryHint: Local media and canvas videos, add as needed
edit.importHint: Drag files to import. Preview originals, then click ＋ or drag to the timeline.
edit.emptyText: Import external video/audio, or pick canvas media from the left.

node.videoHelp: Choose an image or previz as reference; result returns to the canvas with edges kept.
node.timelineHelp: Adds to the local media library and appends to the Edit timeline; previz exports use the same path.

export.title: Export preview
export.subtitle: Switch cameras by shot, or output one camera. Lock and Solo do not change the export.
export.simplifyHint: Limbless mannequin keeps position, facing and height; affects this export only.
export.simplifyNote: Simplified output does not express body performance. Keep original characters for walking, waving, etc.
export.noCharacters: No simplifiable humanoid characters in this project.
export.sizeHelp: A single camera uses its own aspect; shot switching uses the canvas aspect and letterboxes to preserve composition. Recording is real-time; keep the app in front. Canvas audio is reference only and is not mixed into the export.
export.downloadedFull: Video downloaded; canvas is full, so no video node was added.

reference.refSubtitle: Each shot exports start/end frames, timing and a manifest; ZIP downloads locally, no video generation is submitted.
reference.refProgress: Uses each shot’s camera; end frame is sampled before the shot ends so it never spills into the next shot.

template.tplSubtitle: Templates lay out nodes and connections, collapsed into one card by default.
template.tplScriptText: Open the current project script to chat, continue or revise with Creative Assistant.
template.tplScriptHint: Reuse the current script; no duplicate project.
template.tplStoryText: Ask Creative Assistant to organize literary storyboards and asset prompts, preview then adopt.
template.tplNote: Reference workflows only create nodes; they never call models or consume quota. Use existing tools for images, OiiOii CLI for video, and import finished audio.

script.title: Script writing
script.welcomeText: Tell me what you want to make, or paste an existing script. We’ll turn it into shots together.
script.starter1: Help me shape a story idea
script.starter2: Review my script’s pacing and logic
script.starter3: Discuss characters and dialogue with me
script.placeholder: Share your idea, or paste a script…
script.actionHelp: Discussion only gives advice; generate/rewrite/continue shows a preview before you adopt it.
script.footer: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for newline · Discussion never overwrites the script

creative.title: Creative Assistant
creative.docHelp: Paste a script, or select a passage for the assistant to rewrite.
creative.docPlaceholder: Edit or paste a script here…
creative.briefPlaceholder: Story style, character relationships, and settings to preserve…
creative.settingsHelp: The assistant uses project text. Calls consume your API quota.
creative.promptPlaceholder: Share your idea, or describe what to change…
creative.sendHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for newline
creative.disclosureNode: Node text, recent discussion and project settings are sent to your configured model. Billing follows the provider.
creative.disclosureProject: Script, storyboard, asset settings and recent discussion are sent to your configured model. Billing follows the provider.
creative.welcomeTitle: Turn a story into shots, step by step
creative.welcomeText: Discuss the idea first, or go straight to storyboards and asset prompts. Candidates stay in this conversation until you adopt them.
creative.taskEmptyText: Start a storyboard & asset task in chat; results are saved here for review before adoption.
